marmousi_source_position_qualitative_pan.selection_rule: sort the 30 validation Marmousi medium groups by input-only velocity gradient energy, break ties by group_id, and select lower median rank 15 of 30 without reading target wavefields or model errors
marmousi_source_position_qualitative_pan.truth_access: target wavefields remain unopened until the frozen validation evaluation

source_position_distance.spatial: nearest Euclidean x-z distance in metres and divided by domain diagonal
source_position_distance.fixed_parameters: f0, amplitude, onset rule, wavelet, and velocity slice
source_position_distance.reporting_rule: report interpolation and outside-training-position-range cases separately

evidence_boundary.r5c_role: train-only diagnostic; not promotion eligible because its ancestry and frozen RAD weights include historical validation-derived choices
evidence_boundary.algorithm_selection: train-only pilot and group-disjoint train confirmation
evidence_boundary.validation: open once after model, checkpoint, metrics, runtime boundary, and baselines are frozen
evidence_boundary.test_id: open once without retuning only if complete validation passes
evidence_boundary.future_truth_during_adaptation: forbidden until the adapted prediction is serialized

central_hypothesis: A source-conditioned local propagation field, bounded travel-time-gradient warp, and time-shared continuous latent basis preserve complete-transient phase and high-wavenumber content better than matched neural baselines while amortizing a reference LWC-84 solve.

generalization_scope.included: source-position generalization at a fixed 19 Hz source frequency

claim_experiment_map.innovation: rank-32 source-medium spatial anchors are shared across time and mixed by continuous per-time coefficients without autoregressive rollout; the full model is time-query-set-independent, not a single static frequency state
primary_metrics: per-time relative_l2 slope over the final third
comparators: parent without the rank-32 time-shared latent basis
claim_experiment_map.pass_rule: no non-finite prediction, no late-bin divergence, and the final-third error slope and receiver phase metrics improve over every non-collapsed matched neural comparator
claim_experiment_map.allowed_wording: long-horizon stable only if the complete frozen splits pass; otherwise report bounded temporal consistency or a failure diagnostic

claim_experiment_map.innovation: target-free travel-time/phase channels, bounded characteristic warp, local spatial generator, and continuous time-shared latent structure
primary_metrics: space-time k-omega ridge error where supported
claim_experiment_map.pass_rule: family-stratified group-cluster 95% confidence interval for the proposed-minus-neural-baseline high-band and receiver phase errors lies below zero; do not claim dispersion-free behavior
claim_experiment_map.allowed_wording: suppresses learned high-wavenumber or phase error under the evaluated protocol

claim_experiment_map.innovation: local medium structure, source-aware propagation features, characteristic displacement, and continuous time-shared latent anchors
claim_experiment_map.baseline_entry_gate: each baseline must overfit one train record per family, produce non-collapsed energy, and bind parameters, updates, frames, optimizer, and selection split
claim_experiment_map.pass_rule: proposed model has lower complete-split mean error with a family-stratified group-cluster confidence interval below zero and no family reversal
claim_experiment_map.allowed_wording: more accurate than the tested matched DeepONet implementations; never state universal superiority

claim_experiment_map.claim: faster than LWC-84 at matched accuracy
claim_experiment_map.innovation: amortized non-autoregressive complete-transient prediction without a numerical background wave solve
claim_experiment_map.runtime_boundary: same GPU and software environment; synchronized; per instance includes host-to-device velocity transfer, medium encoding, source construction, travel features, full 401-frame 201x201 prediction, inverse normalization, device synchronization, and host materialization; excludes one-time model/checkpoint or solver construction and disk I/O for both methods; adaptation, if studied, is reported separately
claim_experiment_map.reference: fastest verified same-GPU LWC-84 implementation whose numerical error meets the matched accuracy threshold
claim_experiment_map.pass_rule: both mean and P95 speedup exceed 10x while complete-split aggregate and every-family relative_l2 meet the frozen accuracy threshold
claim_experiment_map.allowed_wording: faster at matched reported accuracy only when both the accuracy and runtime gates pass

claim_experiment_map.innovation: CPADC family-calibrated causal correction with abstention
claim_experiment_map.existing_evidence: R7 passed complete 480-record validation and independently frozen 480-record test_id under its registered relative-improvement gate
claim_experiment_map.limitation: R7 does not establish an absolute 5% solver error and must remain separate from solver-level accuracy and speed claims

ablation_order: shared dynamic multiscale spectral adapter if accepted by the train-only gate

reporting.uncertainty_unit: independent medium group, stratified by family
reporting.negative_results: retain failed baseline and adapter gates as diagnostics, not as evidence of universal impossibility
